exportfortranslation-desc:
This extension is used to export articles for translation by freelancers.
It is very Kol-Zchut-specific.
exportfortranslation-special-text: This page allows you to prepare articles for freelance translation.
exportfortranslation-error-revision-not-: Revision $1 could not be found, so it cannot be exported for translation.
exportfortranslation-error-page-has-no-r: The page "$1" has no revision, so it cannot be exported for translation.
exportfortranslation-error-revision-wron: Revision $1 is not a revision of the page "$2", so it cannot be exported for translation.
exportfortranslation-error-revision-text: The text of revision $1 of the page "$2" is hidden, so it cannot be exported for translation.
exportfortranslation-error-revision-not-: Revision $1 of the page "$2" has no text that can be exported for translation.
